sloka: इह तेनाप्रवेष्टव्यं प्रविष्टस्य वधो भवेत् ।वनं मत्संश्रयं येन दूषितं रुधिरस्रवैः ॥४-११-५३॥।।
transliteration: iha tenāpraveṣṭavyaṁ praviṣṭasya vadho bhavet ।vanaṁ matsaṁśrayaṁ yena dūṣitaṁ rudhirasravaiḥ ॥4-11-53॥।।

translations.english: 'Whoever has desecrated this forest, protected by me, with drops of blood is forbidden to enter this place. Once he does it, he will die.
